rows.grounds: compound anugraha+arthaṃ used adverbially for the sake of grace
feminine nominative singular participle of prādurbhū

items.question: Why did the eternal one manifest for the worlds?
premises: The eternal one manifested for grace of worlds.
items.inference: Manifestation is for grace of worlds.
uncertainties: Exact subject is supplied by prior context, not by this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Manifested eternally for the grace of the worlds.
